verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an Online Services account that can be used 'anytime, anywhere', with authorized-representative and multi-user access. Nothing in the pack describes the sign-in or identity-verification method: no MFA type, and no confirmation that it avoids biometric liveness, in-person proofing, or a mailed PIN. The /e-services/ account paths were robots-disallowed and never fetched, so the sign-in method is unevidenced for an axis that clearly applies to a government online-account portal.
